bundle.shortDescription: A unified document workspace: read, write and organize Markdown and the files around it. Free and open source.
bundle.longDescription: PerMark is a unified document workspace: one place to read, write and organize Markdown and the files around it. Any Markdown file opens as a clean page you can edit, notes save themselves, and a project folder becomes a place to follow, review and steer what your AI agents write. AI speeds the work; your vision steers it. Works with any AI tool, or with none.
